storage.title: Storage & Quota
storage.subtitle: Where the site's content lives — all inside free tiers
storage.dbSub: Content, progress, cache — served from our own site only
storage.cacheSub: Old entries are removed automatically (LRU) so the database never fills up
storage.bandwidthSub: Text-only pages (~0.2 MB per visit) — audio runs in your browser, video calls run peer-to-peer
storage.poolSub: Add several free-tier storage accounts; when one runs out the next takes over automatically, or switch manually
storage.poolEmpty: No storage accounts yet. Everything already works without them — add an account only if you upload heavy media someday.
storage.tokenHint: Same value as the STORAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable on Vercel
storage.noteTitle: How the cost stays at zero
noteItems: All lessons, stories and words are stored on our own site — no outside host, nothing to pay
Pronunciation audio is generated by your browser itself — unlimited and free
AI answers use your own Gemini key — the site spends nothing
Video calls connect learners directly (peer-to-peer) — no media server bill
